goal: Play a full round: put out fires, rescue everyone, refill water

audit.summary: Only one round was played, and it never got past the lobby: the round could not start, so none of the firefighting systems (fire, hose, water, rescue, doors) were exercised. The mission start flow looks broken.

anomalies.title: Mission Board 'Pick a call' prompt never triggers, so the round cannot start
anomalies.expected: Triggering the Mission Board prompt selects a call and starts the alarm, then teleports players to the Town.
anomalies.observed: Round 1 judge reported high severity: the prompt never triggers and the round cannot start. goal_met is false. No gameplay counters (fires_extinguished, water_used, rescued, rounds_completed) appear at all, while city and traffic setup counters are populated.

anomalies.title: SquadPad 'Change call' prompt does not trigger
anomalies.expected: Interacting with the SquadPad lets the player change the selected call.
anomalies.observed: Round 1 judge reported high severity: the prompt does not respond. This is a second lobby prompt failing in the same round, which points to a shared cause such as prompt setup, distance or enablement.

anomalies.title: No gameplay telemetry produced, so core systems are unverified
anomalies.expected: A full round produces counters for fires, water, rescues and Blame results, and the playbook issues (hose not extinguishing, no way to drop a carried pet) can be checked.
anomalies.observed: Round 1 counters contain only world-build, traffic and data counters. Hose, fire, water, rescue and drop behavior are untested, so the playbook issues remain unverified.

anomalies.title: Player position inconsistent with walk_to arrival
anomalies.expected: After walk_to arrives, the player's position and the 'near' list agree.
anomalies.observed: Round 1 low-severity bug: the position and the 'near' list were inconsistent after walk_to. This may explain why the prompts could not be triggered, if the player was not actually in range.

verdict.evidence: After the rewrite, the round still cannot start: goal_met is false, no gameplay counters (fires_extinguished, rescued, rounds_completed) appear, and the judge reports 'Round stuck in Lobby'. Errors went from 0 before to 1 after: 'LobbyService:7: attempt to index nil with 'pads''.
regressions: New LobbyService server error at line 7 (attempt to index nil with 'pads'); errors rose from 0 to 1

Round stuck in Lobby, so the Mission Board prompt anomaly is not resolved

conclusion.root_cause: Most likely a testing artefact, not a game bug. The Mission Board prompt (Workspace.Map.Station.Lobby.MissionBoard.BoardPrompt) is correctly configured: Enabled, HoldDuration 0, MaxActivationDistance 16, no line-of-sight requirement, and the player was in range at about 6.6 studs. The client showed it (PromptShown fired for BoardPrompt) and then hid it. A fresh control ProximityPrompt created beside the player also never fired Triggered when driven by InputHoldBegin/InputHoldEnd from the client probe. So the failure comes from the synthetic prompt trigger in the test harness, not from the board prompt itself. I did not read the server-side BoardPrompt.Triggered handler in LobbyService (the file excerpt was cut off before it) and did not test it directly. If the bug is real, it would be in that handler, which is where LobbyService wires the board prompt to Choose and Launch. The missing gameplay counters (fires_extinguished, rounds_completed and the rest) follow from the round never launching, because the prompt was never triggered.
conclusion.evidence: Probes 4 and 5: BoardPrompt.Triggered did not fire after InputHoldBegin/InputHoldEnd at 6.6 studs, and the fresh control ProximityPrompt (HoldDuration 0, distance 16) also did not fire. Probe 7: PromptShown and PromptHidden fired for BoardPrompt, but PromptTriggered stayed empty. The prompt properties are valid and the player is in the lobby (InstanceId "", SquadId ""), so nothing in the prompt setup blocks it.
conclusion.fix_hint: No change to the prompt setup is needed. To check the real path, read the BoardPrompt.Triggered handler in LobbyService and drive it with a real player input, or call the server hooks _join and _launch from a Server probe. If the handler turns out to be gated, for example by the cooldown/ready() check or by requiring a squad leader before it calls Choose and Launch, fix that gate in LobbyService so a lone player at the board can pick a call and start the round.

--!strict
-- LobbyService [owner: G3]. The fire station is the LOBBY. Players spawn on the StationSpawn pads.
-- A big Mission Board (tag MissionBoard: SurfaceGui + ProximityPrompt + ClickDetector) lists
-- MissionCatalog; 3 glowing queue pads (tag SquadPad, attr PadId) on the apron each show their
-- squad's call + "2/4 READY". Stepping on a pad joins its squad; the first player on a pad starts a
-- countdown (LobbyConfig.CountdownSeconds, cut to FullCountdownSeconds when the squad is full, reset
-- when the pad empties). At 3..2..1 the station alarm lamps flash; at 0 the alarm blares and the
-- squad launches into its OWN mission instance (MissionService:StartMission), so several pads count
-- down and launch in parallel. On MissionService.MissionEnded the squad comes home ("Welcome back,
-- heroes (mostly)"). Idle fun: slide the fire pole, ring the bell, honk truck 67; standing still
-- labels you "on coffee break". Queue/countdown rules live in the pure ReplicatedStorage/Lobby/LobbyQueue.
-- LobbyConfig.UseLobby = false keeps v1's single auto-round (remotes are still declared).
--
-- Public API (contract, docs/game/03-tech-architecture.md §10 "v1.5 additions"):
--   LobbyService:GetSquads(): { Types.Squad }
--   LobbyService:GetSquad(squadId: string): Types.Squad?
--   LobbyService:Join(player: Player, padId: number): string?     -- squadId; first on a pad leads
--   LobbyService:Leave(player: Player)
--   LobbyService:Choose(player: Player, missionId: string): boolean -- leader only, enabled missions only
--   LobbyService:Launch(squadId: string, missionId: string): string? -- instanceId (MissionService:StartMission)
--   LobbyService:ReturnToLobby(players: { Player })               -- back onto station pads, InstanceId = ""
-- Signals: SquadChanged(squadId: string), Launched(squadId: string, missionId: string, instanceId: string)
-- Remotes: Lobby/Board (S->C all: squads: { Types.Squad }), Lobby/Choose (C->S missionId: string, 2/s),
--          Lobby/Launch (C->S none, 1/s; leader only: cuts the countdown to LaunchCountdown)
--          added: Lobby/Countdown (S->C squad: padId: number, seconds: number (-1 = cancel), title: string)
--                 Lobby/Fx (S->C one: kind: "slide" | "welcome" | "toast", ...args)
-- Writes: Player attrs SquadId ("" = none), InstanceId ("" = in the lobby); Workspace.Map.Station.Lobby;
--         counters squads_launched, lobby_joins, lobby_returns, lobby_bell, lobby_honk, lobby_pole, lobby_afk
-- Test hooks (DevHook only): _join(player, padId), _launch(squadId, missionId), _selftest()

local MissionCatalog = require(ConfigDir:WaitForChild("MissionCatalog") :: ModuleScript) :: { any }
local LobbyQueue = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Lobby"):WaitForChild("LobbyQueue") :: ModuleScript)

local LobbyService = {}
LobbyService.Priority = 55
LobbyService.SquadChanged = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<string>
LobbyService.Launched = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<string, string, string>

type ActiveSquad = Types.Squad & { fallback: boolean? }

local services: { [string]: any } = {}
local byId: { [string]: any } = {}
local queue: LobbyQueue.State? = nil
local built: any = nil -- LobbyProps.Built
local stationModel: Model? = nil
local active: { [string]: ActiveSquad } = {} -- launched squads (InMission), by squadId
local remotes: { [string]: RemoteEvent } = {}

local cooldown: { [string]: number } = {}
local fallbackSeq = 0
local launching: { [number]: boolean } = {} -- userIds between countdown 0 and InstanceId being set

local function count(name: string, n: number?)
	pcall(function()
		require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ForgeTelemetry") :: ModuleScript).count(name, n or 1)
	end)
end

local function catalogIndex()
	table.clear(byId)
	for _, m in MissionCatalog do
		byId[m.id] = m
	end
end

local function firstEnabled(): string?
	for _, m in MissionCatalog do
		if m.enabled then
			return m.id
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function title(missionId: string?): string
	local def = missionId and byId[missionId]
	return if def then def.title else "No call"
end

local function playerById(uid: number): Player?
	return Players:GetPlayerByUserId(uid)
end

local function rootOf(player: Player): BasePart?
	local char = player.Character
	return char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
end

local function inLobby(player: Player): boolean
	local id = player:GetAttribute(Names.Attr.InstanceId)
	return id == nil or id == ""
end

local function ready(key: string, seconds: number): boolean
	local now = os.clock()
	if (cooldown[key] or 0) > now then
		return false
	end
	cooldown[key] = now + seconds
	return true
end

local function playSound(parent: Instance, soundId: string, volume: number?)
	if soundId == nil or soundId == "" then
		return
	end
	local s = Instance.new("Sound")
	s.SoundId = soundId
	s.Volume = volume or 1
	s.RollOffMaxDistance = 160
	s.Parent = parent
	s:Play()
	Debris:AddItem(s, 8)
end

-- "HONK!" / "DING!" pop-up over a part, visible to everyone nearby.
local function popText(adornee: BasePart, str: string, _color: Color3, _height: number)
	Popup.show(adornee, str, "blame") -- small world text for players nearby (ClientLib/WorldPopup)
end

------------------------------------------------------------------ squads as Types.Squad

local function padSquad(pad: LobbyQueue.Pad): Types.Squad?
	if not pad.squadId or #pad.members == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local secs = pad.remaining and math.ceil(pad.remaining) or nil
	return {
		id = pad.squadId,
		padId = pad.padId,
		leader = pad.leader or pad.members[1],
		members = table.clone(pad.members),
		missionId = pad.missionId,
		instanceId = nil,
		state = if secs and secs <= LobbyConfig.FullCountdownSeconds then "Launching" else "Forming",
	}
end
